figures.ask_en: Which two instruments are side by side here, and what is the difference between them?
figures.ask_zh: 這裡並排的是哪兩台儀器？它們的差別是什麼？
figures.a_en: Our two in-line photometer builds, drawn at the same scale. Left is the Pro, the beam-splitter design on a tilted tripod stand. Right is the Slim, the fiber design, which puts the fiber collimator and the flow cuvette into one compact housing. The Slim stands about a quarter of the Pro's height. Both sit in the culture loop and read OD600 without anyone taking a sample.
figures.a_zh: 我們自製的兩台線上光度計，以同一比例畫在一起。左邊是 Pro，分光鏡式設計，架在傾斜的三腳底座上。右邊是 Slim，光纖式設計，把光纖準直器和流動比色槽整合進一個小機殼。Slim 大約只有 Pro 的四分之一高。兩台都接在菌液迴路上，不用取樣就能讀 OD600。
figures.q_en: What does this figure put side by side?
figures.q_zh: 這張圖把什麼東西並排在一起？
opt_en: Our two in-line photometer designs at the same scale: the beam-splitter Pro and the fiber-based Slim
Our photometer next to the commercial BioDrop benchtop spectrophotometer
The first and the last prototype of the bioreactor rig
The lumen-side and shell-side ports of the hollow fiber module
opt_zh: 我們兩種線上光度計設計，以同一比例並排：分光鏡式的 Pro 與光纖式的 Slim
我們的光度計與市售 BioDrop 桌上型分光光度計
生物反應器機組的第一代與最後一代原型
中空纖維模組的管腔側與殼側接口
figures.trap_en: Calling the smaller one a commercial instrument. Both of these are ours; the commercial reference is the BioDrop, which is not in this picture.
figures.trap_zh: 把比較小的那台說成市售儀器。這兩台都是我們做的；市售的對照是 BioDrop，不在這張圖裡。

figures.ask_en: What are the two coloured paths in this diagram, and why do they never meet?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖上的兩條顏色路徑各是什麼？它們為什麼不會交會？
figures.a_en: This is bioreactor version 4, the final loop. Pink is the culture loop: the stirred B. subtilis bottle with its pH probe, the pump, the flow meter, the in-line photometer, the pressure transducers, up through the hollow fiber lumens, past the pinch valve and back. Blue is the protectant path, which leaves the shell side of the membrane through the shell Luer valve to its own output bottle. The only way out of the culture is through the 0.2 micrometre fiber wall, so the cells stay in and only the secreted protein leaves.
figures.a_zh: 這是生物反應器第四版，也是最終版的迴路圖。粉紅色是菌液迴路：裝 B. subtilis 的攪拌瓶與瓶蓋上的 pH 探針、蠕動幫浦、流量計、線上光度計、壓力感測器，往上穿過中空纖維的管腔，經過夾管閥再回到瓶子。藍色是保護劑的路徑，從薄膜的殼側經殼側 Luer 閥流到自己的收集瓶。菌液唯一的出口是 0.2 微米的纖維孔壁，所以細胞留在裡面，只有分泌出來的蛋白離開。
figures.q_en: In this final bioreactor loop diagram, what do the pink and blue paths stand for?
figures.q_zh: 在這張最終版反應器迴路圖裡，粉紅色與藍色的路徑分別代表什麼？
opt_en: Pink is the closed B. subtilis culture loop; blue is the protectant leaving the shell side of the membrane
Pink is hot water for sterilisation; blue is the cooling circuit
Pink is the feed of fresh medium; blue is the waste line to the drain
Pink is the air supply through the filter; blue is the pH dosing line
opt_zh: 粉紅是封閉的 B. subtilis 菌液迴路；藍色是從薄膜殼側離開的保護劑
粉紅是滅菌用熱水；藍色是冷卻迴路
粉紅是新鮮培養基進料；藍色是排到廢液桶的管線
粉紅是經過濾器的供氣；藍色是 pH 加藥管線
figures.trap_en: Describing the blue line as waste. It is the product: the shell-side permeate is what the farm actually uses.
figures.trap_zh: 把藍色那條說成廢液。那是產品：殼側透過液才是最後用到田裡的東西。

figures.ask_en: What does this figure prove, and how strong is that evidence?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖證明了什麼？這個證據有多強？
figures.a_en: The cutaway shows the hollow fiber module: culture runs inside the fiber lumens from feed to retentate, the shell space collects what crosses the 0.2 micrometre wall. Cells are wider than any pore, so they stay in the lumen; the secreted protein crosses. The two plates below are the test: (a) is lumen-side medium and grows colonies, (b) is shell-side medium after a 24 hour run and is clear. Honest limit: this is one plating from one run, not a validated containment claim.
figures.a_zh: 剖面圖畫的是中空纖維模組：菌液從進料端進入纖維管腔、從濃縮端出來，殼側空間收集穿過 0.2 微米孔壁的東西。細胞比任何孔都大，所以留在管腔裡；分泌出來的蛋白可以穿過去。下面兩個培養皿就是驗證：(a) 是管腔側培養基，長出菌落；(b) 是跑了 24 小時之後的殼側培養基，是乾淨的。要誠實講清楚的限制：這是一次實驗的一次塗盤，還不足以當成通過驗證的圍堵宣稱。
figures.q_en: What are the two agar plates at the bottom of this figure?
figures.q_zh: 這張圖下半部的兩個洋菜培養皿是什麼？
opt_en: Lumen-side medium, which grows colonies, and shell-side medium after 24 h, which is clear
A before-and-after of the clean-in-place peroxide wash
Two electroporation voltages compared for colony yield
Medium at pH 5.7 and at pH 7, to test B. subtilis growth
opt_zh: 管腔側培養基（長出菌落）與跑了 24 小時後的殼側培養基（乾淨無菌落）
就地清洗過氧化氫沖洗前後的對照
兩種電穿孔電壓的菌落數比較
pH 5.7 與 pH 7 的培養基，用來測 B. subtilis 生長
figures.trap_en: Overclaiming. Say what it is: one plating, from one run, after 24 hours. It is the only containment evidence the project has.
figures.trap_zh: 把話說得太滿。要講清楚它是什麼：一次實驗、24 小時後、一次塗盤。這是整個專題唯一的圍堵證據。

figures.ask_en: What is on this screen, and which value on it is computed rather than measured?
figures.ask_zh: 這個畫面上是什麼？上面哪一個數值是算出來的、不是量出來的？
figures.a_en: The operator dashboard, 4 September 2026, 53 hours into a recording. It carries OD600 with its sample and reference channels, the flow rate, and the feed, retentate and permeate pressures. Transmembrane pressure is the computed one: it comes from the three measured pressures, not from a sensor of its own.
figures.a_zh: 這是操作儀表板，2026 年 9 月 4 日，紀錄進行到第 53 小時。上面有 OD600 以及它的樣品與參考通道、流量，還有進料、濃縮、透過三個壓力。跨膜壓差（TMP）是算出來的那一個：它是由那三個量到的壓力推出來的，沒有自己的感測器。
figures.q_en: On this operator dashboard, which quantity is derived from the others rather than read from its own sensor?
figures.q_zh: 在這個操作儀表板上，哪一個量是從其他數值推出來的，而不是自己的感測器讀到的？
opt_en: Transmembrane pressure, computed from the feed, retentate and permeate pressures
The flow rate, computed from the pump dial setting
OD600, computed from the pH reading
The feed pressure, computed from the permeate pressure
opt_zh: 跨膜壓差，由進料、濃縮與透過三個壓力算出來
流量，由幫浦轉盤刻度算出來
OD600，由 pH 讀值算出來
進料壓力，由透過側壓力算出來
figures.trap_en: Treating TMP as a fourth sensor reading. There is no TMP sensor; it is arithmetic on three real ones.
figures.trap_zh: 把 TMP 當成第四個感測器讀值。沒有 TMP 感測器，它是用三個真實讀值算出來的。

figures.ask_en: What is this part, and whose criticism does it answer?
figures.ask_zh: 這個零件是什麼？它回應的是誰提出的問題？
figures.a_en: The 3D printed pinch valve, driven by an STS3215 serial servo, squeezing the silicone culture-return tube. It answers the gap Professor Chang Jo-Shu named in June: the design had no driving force to move product across the membrane. Closing the valve raises transmembrane pressure and pushes permeate out to the shell side. It is one of the two servo valves that make a hands-off harvest possible.
figures.a_zh: 這是 3D 列印的夾管閥，由 STS3215 序列伺服機驅動，夾住回流的矽膠管。它回應的是張嘉修教授六月指出的缺口：原本的設計沒有任何驅動力把產物推過薄膜。把閥夾緊會提高跨膜壓差，把透過液推到殼側。這是讓收料可以不用人顧的兩個伺服閥之一。
figures.q_en: What does closing this valve do?
figures.q_zh: 把這個閥夾緊會造成什麼？
opt_en: It raises the transmembrane pressure, which drives permeate across the membrane
It stops the culture from being contaminated by room air
It switches the LED from red to green to induce the circuit
It diverts the culture past the photometer so the light path can be cleaned
opt_zh: 提高跨膜壓差，把透過液推過薄膜
阻止室內空氣污染菌液
把 LED 從紅光切成綠光以誘導線路
讓菌液繞過光度計，以便清潔光程
figures.trap_en: Describing it as a safety shut-off. Its job is to create the driving force for harvest, not to isolate the reactor.
figures.trap_zh: 把它講成安全切斷閥。它的工作是製造收料所需的驅動力，不是隔離反應器。

figures.ask_en: What is this valve for, and which side of the membrane does it sit on?
figures.ask_zh: 這個閥的用途是什麼？它裝在薄膜的哪一側？
figures.a_en: The automated Luer valve on the shell side, a printed gear on the valve handle driven by a serial servo. It seals the opening from the lumen to the shell until a harvest is wanted, so the vessel keeps its medium and nobody has to stand at the bench to take product off.
figures.a_zh: 這是殼側的自動化 Luer 閥，閥把手上裝了列印的齒輪，由序列伺服機驅動。在要收料之前，它把管腔通往殼側的開口封住，所以反應器留得住培養基，也不需要有人守在實驗桌邊收產物。
figures.q_en: Where does this automated valve sit and what does it control?
figures.q_zh: 這個自動閥裝在哪裡？它控制什麼？
opt_en: On the shell side, sealing the lumen-to-shell opening until a harvest is wanted
On the air inlet, controlling aeration of the culture bottle
On the base feed line, controlling the KOH dose
Inside the photometer, switching between the sample and reference beams
opt_zh: 在殼側，在要收料之前封住管腔通往殼側的開口
在進氣口，控制菌液瓶的通氣
在鹼液管線上，控制 KOH 加藥量
在光度計內部，切換樣品光束與參考光束
figures.trap_en: Confusing it with the pinch valve. The pinch valve is on the culture return and makes the pressure; this one is on the shell side and opens the product path.
figures.trap_zh: 跟夾管閥搞混。夾管閥在菌液回流端、負責製造壓力；這一個在殼側，負責打開產物的通路。

figures.ask_en: What is drawn here, and what does each well contain?
figures.ask_zh: 這張剖面圖畫的是什麼？每一格裡面有什麼？
figures.a_en: A cross-section of the Light Plate Apparatus, the LPA. The light path runs from an LED at the bottom of each well, through a diffuser, up into the culture tube sitting in the rack above. Each well is its own light program, so six light conditions run at once in one incubator and the green-versus-red comparison is made on cultures grown side by side.
figures.a_zh: 這是光照板裝置（LPA）的剖面圖。光的路徑從每一格底部的 LED 出發，穿過擴散片，往上照進上方試管架裡的培養管。每一格都有自己的光照程式，所以同一個培養箱裡可以同時跑六種光照條件，綠光與紅光的比較是在並排培養的菌液上做出來的。
figures.q_zh: 這張剖面圖顯示的是什麼？
opt_en: The LPA light path: an LED and a diffuser under each well, lighting the culture tube above it
The optical path inside the in-line photometer, from LED to sensor
A cutaway of the hollow fiber membrane cartridge
The layered containment design of the commercial bioreactor
opt_zh: LPA 的光路：每一格下方有 LED 與擴散片，往上照亮培養管
線上光度計內部從 LED 到感測器的光路
中空纖維薄膜濾芯的剖面
商用反應器的分層圍堵設計
figures.trap_en: Mixing up the LPA with the photometer. The LPA puts light into cultures; the photometer reads light through one.
figures.trap_zh: 把 LPA 跟光度計搞混。LPA 是把光打進菌液，光度計是讓光穿過菌液去讀值。

figures.ask_en: What is this part, and what problem does it solve?
figures.ask_zh: 這個零件是什麼？它解決了什麼問題？
figures.a_en: The printed floating plate for the hydroponic boxes: thirteen bores in rows of four, five and four, a handle clipped at each end, and the seed holders that drop into the bores. A fixed plate makes the root depth drift as the medium level falls through a run; a floating plate falls with the level, so the roots stay at one depth. It floats on a closed hollow frame and sits in a pipette tip box.
figures.a_zh: 這是水耕盒用的 3D 列印浮板：十三個孔，排成四、五、四三列，兩端各夾一個把手，旁邊是放進孔裡的種子座。固定板會讓根的深度隨著實驗中液面下降而跑掉；浮板會跟著液面一起下沉，所以根一直維持在同一個深度。它靠板下封閉的中空框架浮起來，放在吸管尖盒裡使用。
figures.q_en: Why is this plate designed to float rather than being fixed to the box?
figures.q_zh: 這塊板子為什麼設計成會浮動，而不是固定在盒子上？
opt_en: So the roots stay at one depth as the medium level falls through a run
So the plate can be lifted out for weighing without touching the plants
So the plants can be rotated under the light each day
So the box can be stacked with other boxes in the growth chamber
opt_zh: 讓根在實驗過程中液面下降時仍維持在同一個深度
讓板子可以整個拿起來秤重而不碰到植物
讓植物每天可以在燈下換方向
讓盒子可以在生長箱裡疊起來
figures.trap_en: Saying it is for convenience. The reason is experimental: a drifting root depth would confound every reading taken over the run.
figures.trap_zh: 說它只是為了方便。這是實驗上的理由：根的深度一直跑掉，整段實驗的讀值都會被干擾。

figures.ask_en: What has failed here, and what did the team change afterwards?
figures.ask_zh: 這裡壞掉的是什麼？之後團隊改了什麼？
figures.a_en: A connection post snapped off the base plate of the LPA after the overnight run on the shaker. Two screws had been carrying the load; four bear it now. The honest part: the repaired base has not been back on the shaker, so the fix is not yet proven.
figures.a_zh: LPA 底板上的一根連接柱，在整夜的搖床實驗之後從根部斷掉。原本是兩根螺絲在承受負載，現在改成四根。要誠實講的是：修好的底板還沒有再上過搖床，所以這個修正還沒被驗證過。
figures.q_zh: 這張照片記錄的是什麼？
opt_en: A printed connection post that snapped off the LPA base plate during an overnight shaker run
A cracked cuvette window in the photometer light path
A hollow fiber cartridge that leaked under transmembrane pressure
A servo horn that stripped on the pinch valve
opt_zh: LPA 底板上一根列印的連接柱，在整夜搖床實驗中斷裂
光度計光路上破裂的比色槽窗口
在跨膜壓差下滲漏的中空纖維濾芯
夾管閥上滑牙的伺服機搖臂
figures.trap_en: Hiding the unproven part. The repair is a design change that has not been re-tested; say so before a judge finds it.
figures.trap_zh: 把還沒驗證的部分藏起來。這個修正是尚未重測的設計變更；在評審問出來之前自己先講。

figures.ask_en: What is being compared, and what is the headline number?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖在比較什麼？關鍵數字是什麼？
figures.a_en: The Pro and the Slim photometers rendered at the same scale, both lit, each with a short tube of culture out of its flow cell. The Slim stands about a quarter of the Pro's height. The size is the point: the Slim is the build a farm or another team could actually put in a loop, and on the silica ladder it is about five times less sensitive than the Pro but just as straight.
figures.a_zh: Pro 與 Slim 兩台光度計以同一比例算圖，兩台都亮著燈，各自有一小段裝著菌液的管子從流動槽接出來。Slim 大約只有 Pro 的四分之一高。尺寸就是重點：Slim 才是農場或別的隊伍真的有辦法接進迴路裡的版本，在二氧化矽梯度上它的靈敏度大約是 Pro 的五分之一，但一樣是直線。
kw_en: Slim is a quarter the height
figures.q_en: What is the main thing this render is making a point about?
figures.q_zh: 這張算圖主要想說明什麼？
opt_en: Size: the Slim is about a quarter of the Pro's height, at the same scale
Colour: the two builds use different LED wavelengths
Cost: the Slim uses a cheaper sensor than the Pro
Accuracy: the Slim reads closer to the BioDrop than the Pro does
opt_zh: 尺寸：在同一比例下，Slim 大約只有 Pro 的四分之一高
顏色：兩台用的是不同波長的 LED
成本：Slim 用的感測器比 Pro 便宜
準確度：Slim 的讀值比 Pro 更接近 BioDrop
figures.trap_en: Claiming the Slim is the more accurate build. It is the smaller and more reproducible one; the Pro tracks the BioDrop's slope more closely.
figures.trap_zh: 宣稱 Slim 比較準。Slim 是比較小、比較好複製的那一台；在斜率上比較貼近 BioDrop 的是 Pro。
